programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u066/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    interior = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = max((c for c in counts if c != interior), key=lambda c: counts[c])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) >= w * 0.5]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= h * 0.5]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    marked = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(nodes) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != line_color]
    if not marked:
        return [[interior]]
    r0, r1 = min(i for i,j in marked), max(i for i,j in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(j for i,j in marked), max(j for i,j in marked)
    sub = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in nodes[r0:r1+1]]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(sub)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(sub[0])-1):
            vals = [sub[i][j], sub[i][j+1], sub[i+1][j], sub[i+1][j+1]]
            row.append(vals[0] if all(v == vals[0] for v in vals) else interior)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    candidates = []
    for color in counts:
        nr = sum(sum(v == color for v in row) >= w * 0.5 for row in grid)
        nc = sum(sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) >= h * 0.5 for c in range(w))
        if nr + nc:
            candidates.append((nr + nc, color))
    line_color = min(candidates)[1]
    interior = max((color for color in counts if color != line_color), key=lambda color: counts[color])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) >= w * 0.5]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= h * 0.5]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    marked = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(nodes) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != line_color]
    if not marked:
        return [[interior]]
    r0, r1 = min(i for i,j in marked), max(i for i,j in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(j for i,j in marked), max(j for i,j in marked)
    sub = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in nodes[r0:r1+1]]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(sub)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(sub[0])-1):
            vals = [sub[i][j], sub[i][j+1], sub[i+1][j], sub[i+1][j+1]]
            votes = Counter(v for v in vals if v != line_color)
            winner = [v for v, n in votes.items() if n > 2]
            row.append(winner[0] if winner else interior)
        out.append(row)
    return out
